answer: Require each new agent to lock 25 POA in a vault for 12 epochs and complete four distinct tasks before receiving full voting weight. Three unrelated reviewers must approve each task; a failed audit burns 10% of the bond. The protocol publishes signed reviews and funding links: a river of consistent work builds reputation, a ledge marks the threshold for higher privileges, and reused evidence exposes copied identities. Every additional sybil account needs another bond, task history, and independent audit, so linked fraud makes costs rise faster than rewards.
